text:
Maya (CS): quick weekly health check for Catalyst onboarding cohort — focusing on tail (p95/p99) by route + model and streaming vs non-streaming. posting condensed numbers + notes. please chime in if anything looks off :eyes:

Arjun (SRE): thanks — drop the breakdown when you have it, curious about /chat/completions non-streaming numbers

Maya (CS): ```
/route: /chat/completions
  model: redwood-v5-13b
  streaming: p95=210ms, p99=420ms, errors=0.12%
  non-streaming: p95=540ms, p99=1.2s, errors=0.95%

/route: /embed
  model: embed-2-large
  streaming: n/a
  non-streaming: p95=130ms, p99=220ms, errors=0.05%

/route: /summarize (long-docs)
  model: redwood-v5-13b
  streaming: p95=480ms, p99=820ms, errors=0.6%
  non-streaming: p95=1.1s, p99=2.4s, errors=1.8%

weekly spend (Catalyst acct): $5.1k (this week) vs $3.9k baseline
notes: biggest delta = non-streaming tail on /chat/completions and summarize when seq len > 4k tokens
```

Leila (Solutions): non-streaming p99s are definitely harmful to first-time users. looks correlated with user-agent "Catalyst-web-1" and uploads around 11:30 UTC. can we try streaming-by-default for the onboarding flow? :pray:

Nikhil (Eng): confirmed pattern in traces — long KV cache misses during cold starts for large-doc sessions. also saw CPU contention on the dedicated pool during bursts.

telemetry-bot: alert — 11:32:18 UTC spike, ingress timeouts increased, error rate up to 0.92% for /summarize on redwood-v5-13b for 3m

Catalyst PM: seeing this in our UI too. new users hit the summarize flow and then they drop off. any temporary mitigations we can apply quickly?

Arjun (SRE): short-term: roll streaming on for the onboarding route /chat/completions and /summarize for cohort B (config flag). should reduce perceived tail. I'll run a canary in staging then prod. ETA ~30m for staging, 90m for prod if canary looks good.

Maya (CS): medium-term: enable prefix/KV warmup for large-doc sessions and add a small prefetch for first 2 tokens to keep KV hot. Nikhil — can you scope the effort?

Nikhil (Eng): scope: ~6-8 dev hours + 24h validation. we'll also add a guard to fall back to a smaller model (redwood-v1-7b) when seq len > 8k for non-critical background jobs to save spend.

Leila (Solutions): cost note — switching onboarding to streaming cuts token timeouts and reduced spend in our sim by ~18%. not a silver bullet but helpful.

Maya (CS): action items: 1) Arjun — canary streaming toggle for onboarding routes (owner: Arjun) 2) Nikhil — KV warmup + fallback plan (owner: Nikhil) 3) Maya — schedule enablement call with Catalyst for Thu 10:00 PT and share config change notes (owner: Maya) 4) Leila — prepare customer-facing explanation about why streaming improves UX (owner: Leila).

Catalyst PM: Thu 10:00 PT works, thanks — appreciate the quick triage :heart:

Maya (CS): will update thread with canary results. closing for now but will re-open if post-change tail remains > p99 800ms for /chat/completions. :white_check_mark:
